input:
CURRENT SCENE:
因为他们常常搬了家，中国人说，孟母三迁。孟子没有爸爸，所以，他的妈妈更重要。从这儿到那儿，妈妈教孟子很多技能。先她让孟子跟朋友玩儿，然后教他怎么买又便宜又好质量的东西。

ITEMS:

[I149] 因为他们常常搬【了】家   correction: 了 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: habitual action with 常常 does not take 了
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: [+所以]他们常常搬家 — her note: 无聊？add所以
  her past correction: [-他们]搬家每次学到了比较多
  her past correction: 他们⟦才搬了三次家⟧ — her note: 才 + Num. to express “small, few”, but here搬了三次家 is a large quantity

[I150] 【孟母】三迁   correction: (comment, no correction)   strength: error
  checker's note: first appearance of 孟母: briefly introduce who this is
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧和孟母住在一起 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧跟他妈妈常常搬家 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧的妈妈跟孟子一起住在中国 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears

[I151] 妈妈教孟子很多【技能】   correction: 技能 → 东西   strength: suggestion
  rule card (loose_clause_connection, Coherence: connectors): Make the relationship between clauses or sentences clear. Add or choose a connector, a purpose phrase, or a sequence marker that shows the real connection.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: use <connector/purpose/sequence phrase> to show how this sentence connects to the previous clause or sentence.
  her past correction: ⟦妈妈让孟子每天上课，孟子长得很乖，很聪明⟧ — her note: loosely connected, unclear between-sentence relationship
  her past correction: 孟子从早到晚[学了新的东西→学习新知识]
  her past correction: 孟母发现[孩子们→孟子]老是用功工作 — her note: “孩子们” is ambiguous

[I152] 【先她】让孟子跟朋友玩儿   correction: 先她 → 她先   strength: error
  checker's note: the subject comes before 先
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧不是跟朋友玩 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: 孟子的妈妈爱[-她的]小孩子
  her past correction: [-孟子老是]想玩玩

[I153] 然后教他怎么买又便宜【^】又好质量的东西   correction: ∅ → 质量   strength: suggestion
  rule card (ambiguous_pronoun, Coherence: reference): Use 他/她/它/他们 only when it is clear who or what they refer to. If more than one person or thing is possible, repeat the name or use a clear noun phrase.  Pattern: <wrong pronoun> → <clear name/noun phrase>: <pronoun> is ambiguous; it can refer to <possible referent(s)>.
  her past correction: 所以[-他]看什么就吃什么 — her note: this is ambiguous, as the topic is他的朋友
  her past correction: 这个天他请他们[-给他]建议怎么减轻他的家庭的负担 — her note: too many他
  her past correction: 因为[+他]老是去墓地吃祭品

[I154] 然后教他怎么买又便宜又【好质量】的东西   correction: 好质量 → 质量好   strength: error
  checker's note: quality adjective order is reversed
  rule card (collocation_selection, Vocabulary): Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <word/expression> does not normally collocate with <noun/action/situation>; use <correct> instead.  Her terms: Time + 期间, V.得很厉害, 着durative, no了for habit/routine
  her past correction: 然后忙着偷走[优秀→优质]的梨子
  her past correction: 所以[-他]看什么就吃什么 — her note: this is ambiguous, as the topic is他的朋友
  her past correction: 他在这个地方学到了[害得习惯→坏习惯] — her note: 害得 + clause (harmful result)

items.explanation: 常常 shows a habitual action, not one completed action in the story, so do not use 了completed here.
孟母 appears for the first time, so please briefly introduce her, for example as 孟子的妈妈.
It would be more natural to say 东西 here. 妈妈教孟子很多东西 connects better to the examples that follow.
Put the subject before 先: 她先让孟子跟朋友玩儿.
It would be more natural to add 质量: 又便宜又质量好 clearly describes the things he buys.
好质量 does not normally collocate with 东西. Use 质量好 instead.
